fuelcell.name: Fuel-cell soak in the chamber
fuelcell.what: A section runs for hours in a vacuum chamber, and its oxygen supply pressure is traced.
fuelcell.good: The supply pressure holds flat for the whole soak.
fuelcell.bad: The supply pressure sags an hour in and the heater cycles hard to catch it.

hatch.name: Hatch cycling in the altitude chamber
hatch.what: The hatch is opened and latched again at vacuum, twenty times, with the latch forces traced.
hatch.good: Every cycle latches with one hand's force.
hatch.bad: On the twelfth cycle the latch force doubles and stays high.

computer.name: Computer power-transient test
computer.what: The spacecraft bus is switched through its worst transients while the computer runs.
computer.bad: On one transient the computer drops off the line and does not come back by itself.

thruster.name: Thruster firing under vibration
thruster.what: The attitude thrusters are fired on the shaker table, and every valve's current traced.
thruster.good: Every valve opens on command and shuts clean.
thruster.bad: Under vibration, one valve draws current with no command.

chutes.name: Parachute drop
chutes.what: A boilerplate spacecraft is dropped and the drogue and main traced.
chutes.good: Drogue and main open on time and the loads stay in their bands.

GEMINI_SIMS.nominal: A clean climb to orbit. Nothing was wrong.
GEMINI_SIMS.titanctl: A Titan guidance failure: she went off her line.
GEMINI_SIMS.stage2: A second stage that cut off early, short of orbit.
GEMINI_SIMS.seastate: The sea in the landing area was above state 4.
GEMINI_SIMS.offstation: A recovery ship was not on station.

titanctl: On the tape the flight-path angle walks off the planned line, steadily, in one direction.
The Titan's autopilot readout shows one gimbal actuator lagging its command.
stage2: The second stage stopped early, its chamber pressure falling away.
The velocity on the tape stops short of what orbit needs.
nominal: Every Titan channel on the tape stays in its band from liftoff to second-stage cutoff.
